# Face-pipeline test fixtures

Licence-clear images only (issue #1, Seam 3). Every photograph below is a work of the United States
federal government, in the public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. § 105), as marked on its
Wikimedia Commons file page (checked 2026-11-01). Every portrait is credited on its file page to a
White House staff photographer (David Lienemann, Adam Schultz, Pete Souza); the Earth photo to the
Apollo 17 crew. The one other file, `oversized-54mp.heic`, is a generated plain-grey image. None is
a scraped face. The portraits show public officials; Commons notes personality rights for some of
them. They are used only to test face detection and recognition and imply no endorsement.

Downloaded files are Wikimedia Commons thumbnails of the originals (downscaled by Commons) or, where
noted, the Commons file itself, with embedded metadata as served; local modifications are listed per
file. `fixtures.test.ts` checks that this table and the folder list exactly the same files (dotfiles
ignored, no subfolders) and that every row fills all six columns.
